title: Rubico亚洲固收主管：美债收益率或见顶，长端仍有上行空间
speaker: Two Hot

segments.en: Where does that leave rates? When I look at the treasury curve, we're a little bit well above the 5% handle for the US 30-year yield. Do you think we've reached a peak?
segments.zh: 这对利率意味着什么？看看国债收益率曲线，美国30年期收益率已经超过5%。你认为我们已经见顶了吗？

segments.en: We think in the short end, that feels like it's all done. We're quite constructive on the two to five years part of the curve. We don't think we're going to see any hikes anytime soon.
segments.zh: 我们认为短端已经到位。我们对曲线2-5年期部分持建设性看法。我们不认为近期会有加息。

segments.en: On the 30-year, I think we probably target more like 5.25% just because there is going to be a bit more concern on term risk premium and term premium being priced in as we expect inflation might become more embedded.
segments.zh: 对于30年期，我们目标可能在5.25%左右，因为随着通胀可能变得更加根深蒂固，期限风险溢价将被定价。

segments.en: Even if the core inflation comes down, we don't think that means inflation is going to be out of the way anytime soon. Since the war started, most fixed income strategies haven't done well. Do you think that continues?
segments.zh: 即使核心通胀下降，我们也不认为通胀会很快消失。自战争开始以来，大多数固收策略表现不佳。你认为这种情况会持续吗？

segments.en: I think we're still relatively cautious on duration, although we're beginning to feel that the market is beginning to price in our scenarios of higher yields. So we're beginning to get there.
segments.zh: 我认为我们对久期仍相对谨慎，尽管我们开始感觉到市场正在计入我们预期的高收益率情景。所以我们正在接近那个点。
